instruct: Castilian Spanish accent from Spain (c and z pronounced as 'th'), natural and human, never robotic. Male narrator in his thirties. Deep, warm, slightly husky voice of mystery, like a late-night documentary host. Calm pace, intimate, with suspense in the pauses.

lineas.texto: Imagina que esta noche te duermes… y te despiertas en el año mil trescientos. Sin móvil. Sin luz. Y con un gallo gritándote en la oreja antes de que salga el sol.
